ruling.scope: Ben, 2026-08-25 09:44, replying to the Monkey's ask about ci.yml being a protected path: "The fix is in ci.yml, which is the protected path you have not ruled on. Those two open items are the same knot. Give me the word and I will send a lane to make the job distinguish 'this version is not published yet' from 'this version is published and wrong', with the second still failing hard. < do it". Ben confirmed the record on 2026-08-25 13:34 with "1 write it", and the Monkey recorded it at his instruction. Authorises editing .github/workflows/ci.yml for ONE purpose: break the release bootstrap deadlock, so a pre-release version whose release does not exist yet can reach a green CI run. Kernel WASM digest, kernel head, fixtures, corpus and release.yml remain outside scope.
